metadata.title: A Few Beverage Recipes And How To Mix Them
metadata.notes: Folleto promocional publicado por International Silver Company durante la Prohibición en EE.UU. Presenta recetas de bebidas no alcohólicas y publicita los juegos de mezcladores de plata equipados con el nuevo tapón patentado Insico Stopper. Las recetas fueron aportadas en parte por California Fruit Growers Exchange, Hav's Fruit Juice Co., W. A. Taylor & Co. y Welch Grape Juice Co.

sections.title: Foreword
sections.content_original: In this little book we present a number of recipes for delicious non-alcoholic drinks, and since so much depends upon the manner in which they should be prepared and mixed, we show a number of our most popular styles of silverplated mixers, all of which are equipped with the new patented Insico Stopper. These recipes comprising appetizers for the dinner, egg-noggs and fruit cups for the luncheon table, and lemonades, punches, etc. for the sultry summer's afternoon and evening, have been carefully tested, and each presents a new flavor, a different flavor to tempt and refresh the most capricious palate.
sections.content_es: En este pequeño libro presentamos una serie de recetas de deliciosas bebidas no alcohólicas, y dado que mucho depende de la forma en que deben prepararse y mezclarse, mostramos varios de nuestros estilos más populares de mezcladores plateados, todos equipados con el nuevo tapón patentado Insico Stopper. Estas recetas, que incluyen aperitivos para la cena, ponches de huevo (egg-noggs) y copas de frutas para la mesa del almuerzo, así como limonadas, ponches, etc. para las tardes y noches sofocantes de verano, han sido cuidadosamente probadas, y cada una presenta un sabor nuevo, un sabor diferente para tentar y refrescar el paladar más caprichoso.

sections.content_es: Por muchas de las recetas de este libro estamos en deuda con: California Fruit Growers Exchange; Hav's Fruit Juice Co.; W. A. Taylor & Co.; Welch Grape Juice Co.

sections.title: The Insico Stopper
sections.content_original: The INSICO STOPPER. U. S. Patent No. 1,614,236. Canadian Patent No. 270,898. The Insico Stopper is the new, modern, all-metal stopper for beverage mixers. It is similar in appearance to the old-fashioned cork stopper but possesses infinite advantages over it. It is hygienic and easy to clean because of the detachable metal cup. It neither shrinks nor becomes odorous with age. It is a constant guarantee of freshness and purity. The cross-section illustration shows its construction and the metal-tight seal. Mixers and Mixer Sets equipped with the all-metal Insico Stopper may be procured from leading dealers.
sections.content_es: El TAPÓN INSICO. Patente EE.UU. Nº 1.614.236. Patente canadiense Nº 270.898. El tapón Insico es el nuevo tapón moderno, totalmente metálico, para mezcladores de bebidas. Es similar en apariencia al antiguo tapón de corcho, pero posee infinitas ventajas sobre él. Es higiénico y fácil de limpiar gracias a la copa metálica desmontable. No se encoge ni adquiere olor con el tiempo. Es una garantía constante de frescura y pureza. La ilustración en sección transversal muestra su construcción y el sellado hermético metálico. Los mezcladores y juegos de mezcladores equipados con el tapón Insico totalmente metálico pueden adquirirse a través de los distribuidores principales.

recipes.method_original: One part Five Fruit, two parts sparkling white grape juice, two parts sparkling water and three parts ice water. Mix thoroughly and frappe in mixer with plenty of fine shaved ice. Pour into cocktail glasses. Four portions.
recipes.method_es: Una parte de Five Fruit, dos partes de jugo espumoso de uva blanca, dos partes de agua con gas y tres partes de agua helada. Mezclar bien y frapear en el mezclador con abundante hielo finamente picado. Verter en copas de cóctel. Cuatro porciones.
recipes.raw_text: Ambrosia. One part Five Fruit, two parts sparkling white grape juice, two parts sparkling water and three parts ice water. Mix thoroughly and frappe in mixer with plenty of fine shaved ice. Pour into cocktail glasses. Four portions.

recipes.method_original: One portion Five Fruit, four portions sweet cider, two portions Panama Punch, and three portions water. Mix thoroughly and frappe in mixer with fine shaved ice. Pour into cocktail glasses. Four portions.
recipes.method_es: Una porción de Five Fruit, cuatro porciones de sidra dulce, dos porciones de Panama Punch y tres porciones de agua. Mezclar bien y frapear en el mezclador con hielo finamente picado. Verter en copas de cóctel. Cuatro porciones.
recipes.raw_text: Tantalus. One portion Five Fruit, four portions sweet cider, two portions Panama Punch, and three portions water. Mix thoroughly and frappe in mixer with fine shaved ice. Pour into cocktail glasses. Four portions.

ingredients.notes: cantidad igual a la suma de los anteriores

recipes.method_original: Equal portions of Five Fruit and strong black coffee. Add an equal amount of water. Mix in mixer with plenty of fine shaved ice and serve in cocktail glasses with slice of lemon and sprig of mint. Four portions.
recipes.method_es: Porciones iguales de Five Fruit y café negro fuerte. Añadir una cantidad igual de agua. Mezclar en el mezclador con abundante hielo finamente picado y servir en copas de cóctel con una rodaja de limón y una ramita de menta. Cuatro porciones.
recipes.garnish: rodaja de limón y ramita de menta
recipes.raw_text: Cafe Noir. Equal portions of Five Fruit and strong black coffee. Add an equal amount of water. Mix in mixer with plenty of fine shaved ice and serve in cocktail glasses with slice of lemon and sprig of mint. Four portions.

recipes.method_original: One cup orange juice, four tablespoonfuls lemon juice, three tablespoonfuls of strained honey and a dash of bitters. Mix the honey and fruit juices thoroughly in mixer before adding thin shaved ice and bitters. Frappe and serve in cocktail glasses. Garnish with twist of orange peel. Four portions.
recipes.method_es: Una taza de jugo de naranja, cuatro cucharadas de jugo de limón, tres cucharadas de miel colada y un golpe de bitters. Mezclar la miel y los jugos de fruta cuidadosamente en el mezclador antes de añadir el hielo finamente picado y los bitters. Frapear y servir en copas de cóctel. Decorar con una espiral de cáscara de naranja. Cuatro porciones.
recipes.raw_text: Honey Boy. One cup orange juice, four tablespoonfuls lemon juice, three tablespoonfuls of strained honey and a dash of bitters. Mix the honey and fruit juices thoroughly in mixer before adding thin shaved ice and bitters. Frappe and serve in cocktail glasses. Garnish with twist of orange peel. Four portions.

ingredients.notes: en sustitución de la miel colada

recipes.method_original: Same as Honey Boy, but with substitution of maple syrup for strained honey. Four portions.
recipes.method_es: Igual que el Honey Boy, pero sustituyendo la miel colada por sirope de arce. Cuatro porciones.
recipes.raw_text: Maple Leaf. Same as Honey Boy, but with substitution of maple syrup for strained honey. Four portions.

recipes.method_original: Six tablespoonfuls ginger syrup, four tablespoonfuls lemon juice, four tablespoonfuls orange juice, one half cup sparkling water and a few grains of salt. Mix thoroughly and frappe in mixer. Pour into cocktail glasses. Four portions.
recipes.method_es: Seis cucharadas de sirope de jengibre, cuatro cucharadas de jugo de limón, cuatro cucharadas de jugo de naranja, media taza de agua con gas y unos pocos granos de sal. Mezclar bien y frapear en el mezclador. Verter en copas de cóctel. Cuatro porciones.
recipes.raw_text: Ginger Stinger. Six tablespoonfuls ginger syrup, four tablespoonfuls lemon juice, four tablespoonfuls orange juice, one half cup sparkling water and a few grains of salt. Mix thoroughly and frappe in mixer. Pour into cocktail glasses. Four portions.

recipes.method_original: Six tablespoonfuls grapefruit juice, two tablespoonfuls lemon juice, four tablespoonfuls orange juice, powdered sugar to taste, one cup sparkling water and a few grains of salt. Mix thoroughly and frappe in mixer filled with fine shaved ice. Pour into cocktail glasses and garnish with sprigs of fresh mint. Four portions.
recipes.method_es: Seis cucharadas de jugo de pomelo, dos cucharadas de jugo de limón, cuatro cucharadas de jugo de naranja, azúcar en polvo al gusto, una taza de agua con gas y unos pocos granos de sal. Mezclar bien y frapear en el mezclador lleno de hielo finamente picado. Verter en copas de cóctel y decorar con ramitas de menta fresca. Cuatro porciones.
recipes.raw_text: Grapefruit Cocktail. Six tablespoonfuls grapefruit juice, two tablespoonfuls lemon juice, four tablespoonfuls orange juice, powdered sugar to taste, one cup sparkling water and a few grains of salt. Mix thoroughly and frappe in mixer filled with fine shaved ice. Pour into cocktail glasses and garnish with sprigs of fresh mint. Four portions.

recipes.method_original: For each drink, take one egg, one half cup of grape juice, and powdered sugar to taste. Beat egg yolk and white together with fork. Add sugar and grape juice and frappe in mixer with plenty of fine shaved ice. Pour into tall glass.
recipes.method_es: Por cada bebida, tomar un huevo, media taza de jugo de uva y azúcar en polvo al gusto. Batir la yema y la clara del huevo con un tenedor. Añadir el azúcar y el jugo de uva y frapear en el mezclador con abundante hielo finamente picado. Verter en un vaso alto.
recipes.raw_text: Grape Egg-nogg. For each drink, take one egg, one half cup of grape juice, and powdered sugar to taste. Beat egg yolk and white together with fork. Add sugar and grape juice and frappe in mixer with plenty of fine shaved ice. Pour into tall glass.

recipes.method_original: For each portion, beat one egg thoroughly, add one half cup orange juice, one tablespoonful lemon juice, and sugar to taste. Mix thoroughly and frappe in mixer. Serve in tall glass.
recipes.method_es: Por cada porción, batir bien un huevo, añadir media taza de jugo de naranja, una cucharada de jugo de limón y azúcar al gusto. Mezclar bien y frapear en el mezclador. Servir en un vaso alto.
recipes.raw_text: Orange Egg-nogg. For each portion, beat one egg thoroughly, add one half cup orange juice, one tablespoonful lemon juice, and sugar to taste. Mix thoroughly and frappe in mixer. Serve in tall glass.

recipes.method_original: Juice of two lemons, three quarters pint of water, one half pint grape juice, powdered sugar to taste. Mix thoroughly in mixer half filled with thin shaved ice and serve in tall glasses. Four portions.
recipes.method_es: Jugo de dos limones, tres cuartos de pinta de agua, media pinta de jugo de uva, azúcar en polvo al gusto. Mezclar bien en el mezclador medio lleno de hielo finamente picado y servir en vasos altos. Cuatro porciones.
recipes.raw_text: Grape Juice Lemonade. Juice of two lemons, three quarters pint of water, one half pint grape juice, powdered sugar to taste. Mix thoroughly in mixer half filled with thin shaved ice and serve in tall glasses. Four portions.

recipes.method_original: One half cup orange juice, one quarter cup lemon juice, one cup white grape juice, one cup sweet cider, powdered sugar to taste. Mix thoroughly in mixer. Pour into tall glasses in which have been placed large pieces of ice. Four portions.
recipes.method_es: Media taza de jugo de naranja, un cuarto de taza de jugo de limón, una taza de jugo de uva blanca, una taza de sidra dulce, azúcar en polvo al gusto. Mezclar bien en el mezclador. Verter en vasos altos en los que se han colocado grandes trozos de hielo. Cuatro porciones.
recipes.raw_text: Cider Punch. One half cup orange juice, one quarter cup lemon juice, one cup white grape juice, one cup sweet cider, powdered sugar to taste. Mix thoroughly in mixer. Pour into tall glasses in which have been placed large pieces of ice. Four portions.

recipes.name_es: Ponche de Naranja y Ginger Ale
recipes.method_original: One cup of orange juice, one cup grapefruit juice, two thirds cup powdered sugar, one cup grated or chopped pineapple, one half pint of water. Add sugar to the combined fruit juices and water and frappe in mixer. Add pineapple and fill tall glasses two-thirds full. Add plenty of fine shaved ice and fill with ginger ale. Four portions.
recipes.method_es: Una taza de jugo de naranja, una taza de jugo de pomelo, dos tercios de taza de azúcar en polvo, una taza de piña rallada o picada, media pinta de agua. Añadir el azúcar a la mezcla de jugos de fruta y agua y frapear en el mezclador. Añadir la piña y llenar vasos altos hasta los dos tercios. Añadir abundante hielo finamente picado y rellenar con ginger ale. Cuatro porciones.
recipes.raw_text: Orange-Ale Punch. One cup of orange juice, one cup grapefruit juice, two thirds cup powdered sugar, one cup grated or chopped pineapple, one half pint of water. Add sugar to the combined fruit juices and water and frappe in mixer. Add pineapple and fill tall glasses two-thirds full. Add plenty of fine shaved ice and fill with ginger ale. Four portions.

recipes.method_original: One half pint of grape juice, juice of two lemons, and powdered sugar to taste. Mix thoroughly with plenty of thin shaved ice. Pour into tall glasses and fill with ginger ale. Four portions.
recipes.method_es: Media pinta de jugo de uva, jugo de dos limones y azúcar en polvo al gusto. Mezclar bien con abundante hielo finamente picado. Verter en vasos altos y rellenar con ginger ale. Cuatro porciones.
recipes.raw_text: Gingeree. One half pint of grape juice, juice of two lemons, and powdered sugar to taste. Mix thoroughly with plenty of thin shaved ice. Pour into tall glasses and fill with ginger ale. Four portions.

ingredients.item_es: ginger ale o agua con gas

recipes.method_original: Four parts of Five Fruit and several dashes of Angostura Bitters and one egg. Shake together with plenty of fine shaved ice. Pour into tall glasses and add ginger ale or sparkling water. Four portions.
recipes.method_es: Cuatro partes de Five Fruit, varios golpes de amargo Angostura y un huevo. Agitar junto con abundante hielo finamente picado. Verter en vasos altos y añadir ginger ale o agua con gas. Cuatro porciones.
recipes.raw_text: Sizzler. Four parts of Five Fruit and several dashes of Angostura Bitters and one egg. Shake together with plenty of fine shaved ice. Pour into tall glasses and add ginger ale or sparkling water. Four portions.

ingredients.notes: se infiere por contexto OCR; el original es ilegible

recipes.method_original: One pint of grape juice, the juice of three limes, and powdered sugar to taste. Shake well in mixer and pour into tall glasses half filled with thin shaved ice. Add sparkling water.
recipes.method_es: Una pinta de jugo de uva, el jugo de tres limas y azúcar en polvo al gusto. Agitar bien en el mezclador y verter en vasos altos medio llenos de hielo finamente picado. Añadir agua con gas.
recipes.raw_text: [Lime Rickey]. One pint of [grape juice], the juice of three limes, and powdered sugar to taste. Shake well in mixer and pour into tall glasses half filled with thin shaved ice. Add sparkling water.

recipes.method_original: Equal parts of milk, water and orange juice, with sugar to taste. Shake water, milk and sugar until they are thoroughly mixed. Pour in orange juice quickly and shake vigorously until thoroughly combined. Serve in large glasses.
recipes.method_es: Partes iguales de leche, agua y jugo de naranja, con azúcar al gusto. Agitar el agua, la leche y el azúcar hasta que estén bien mezclados. Verter rápidamente el jugo de naranja y agitar vigorosamente hasta que esté completamente integrado. Servir en vasos grandes.
recipes.raw_text: Milk Orangeade. Equal parts of milk, water and orange juice, with sugar to taste. Shake water, milk and sugar until they are thoroughly mixed. Pour in orange juice quickly and shake vigorously until thoroughly combined. Serve in large glasses.

recipes.method_original: For each portion take two tablespoonfuls lemon juice, powdered sugar to taste, six tablespoonfuls milk, one half cup of water. Add milk to water and then add sugar. Mix thoroughly. Pour in lemon juice quickly and shake vigorously until thoroughly combined. Serve in a large glass.
recipes.method_es: Por cada porción, tomar dos cucharadas de jugo de limón, azúcar en polvo al gusto, seis cucharadas de leche y media taza de agua. Añadir la leche al agua y después añadir el azúcar. Mezclar bien. Verter rápidamente el jugo de limón y agitar vigorosamente hasta que esté completamente integrado. Servir en un vaso grande.
recipes.raw_text: Cream Lemonade. For each portion take two tablespoonfuls lemon juice, powdered sugar to taste, six tablespoonfuls milk, one half cup of water. Add milk to water and then add sugar. Mix thoroughly. Pour in lemon juice quickly and shake vigorously until thoroughly combined. Serve in a large glass.

recipes.method_original: One half pint of grape juice, one half pint of cider and mix thoroughly in mixer with plenty of thin shaved ice. Pour into tall glasses half filled with ice. Add sparkling water. Four portions.
recipes.method_es: Media pinta de jugo de uva, media pinta de sidra; mezclar bien en el mezclador con abundante hielo finamente picado. Verter en vasos altos medio llenos de hielo. Añadir agua con gas. Cuatro porciones.
recipes.raw_text: Manhattan Cup. One half pint of grape juice, one half pint of cider and mix thoroughly in mixer with plenty of thin shaved ice. Pour into tall glasses half filled with ice. Add sparkling water. Four portions.

recipes.method_original: Same as Manhattan Cup with the addition of one half pint of loganberry juice. Six portions.
recipes.method_es: Igual que la Copa Manhattan con la adición de media pinta de jugo de loganberry (mora-frambuesa). Seis porciones.
recipes.raw_text: Bronx Cup. Same as Manhattan Cup with the addition of one half pint of loganberry juice. Six portions.

recipes.method_original: One quarter cup orange juice, one half cup sweet cider, two tablespoonfuls lemon juice, one half cup white grape juice, and sugar to taste. Mix together and frappe in mixer. Pour into medium size tumblers, or punch cups. Four portions.
recipes.method_es: Un cuarto de taza de jugo de naranja, media taza de sidra dulce, dos cucharadas de jugo de limón, media taza de jugo de uva blanca y azúcar al gusto. Mezclar todo y frapear en el mezclador. Verter en vasos de tamaño mediano o copas de ponche. Cuatro porciones.
recipes.raw_text: Colonial Punch. One quarter cup orange juice, one half cup sweet cider, two tablespoonfuls lemon juice, one half cup white grape juice, and sugar to taste. Mix together and frappe in mixer. Pour into medium size tumblers, or punch cups. Four portions.

recipes.method_original: Four tablespoonfuls of lemon juice, eight tablespoonfuls of orange juice, powdered sugar to taste, one cup of juice from canned pineapple, two cups sparkling water. Shake thoroughly in mixer with plenty of thin shaved ice. Serve in high narrow tumblers which have been frosted by dipping the edges quickly in lemon juice and then into coarse sugar. Place a small slice of canned pineapple on top and a sprig of mint and two straws in the center; add a large cherry or a fresh strawberry, and serve. Four portions.
recipes.method_es: Cuatro cucharadas de jugo de limón, ocho cucharadas de jugo de naranja, azúcar en polvo al gusto, una taza de jugo de piña en conserva, dos tazas de agua con gas. Agitar bien en el mezclador con abundante hielo finamente picado. Servir en vasos altos y estrechos previamente escarchados sumergiendo rápidamente sus bordes en jugo de limón y después en azúcar gruesa. Colocar una pequeña rodaja de piña en conserva encima y una ramita de menta y dos pajitas en el centro; añadir una cereza grande o una fresa fresca, y servir. Cuatro porciones.
recipes.glassware: vaso alto y estrecho (high narrow tumbler) escarchado
recipes.garnish: rodaja de piña, ramita de menta, dos pajitas y una cereza grande o fresa fresca
recipes.raw_text: Cameo Punch. Four tablespoonfuls of lemon juice, eight tablespoonfuls of orange juice, powdered sugar to taste, one cup of juice from canned pineapple, two cups sparkling water. Shake thoroughly in mixer with plenty of thin shaved ice. Serve in high narrow tumblers which have been frosted by dipping the edges quickly in lemon juice and then into coarse sugar. Place a small slice of canned pineapple on top and a sprig of mint and two straws in the center; add a large cherry or a fresh strawberry, and serve. Four portions.

ingredients.item_es: ginger ale o agua con gas

recipes.method_original: Two parts of Five Fruit to one part of cream. Shake well and frappe in mixer. Pour into tall glasses half filled with fine ice. Add ginger ale or sparkling water. Four portions.
recipes.method_es: Dos partes de Five Fruit por una parte de crema. Agitar bien y frapear en el mezclador. Verter en vasos altos medio llenos de hielo fino. Añadir ginger ale o agua con gas. Cuatro porciones.
recipes.raw_text: Mandarin. Two parts of Five Fruit to one part of cream. Shake well and frappe in mixer. Pour into tall glasses half filled with fine ice. Add ginger ale or sparkling water. Four portions.

ingredients.item_es: vermut no alcohólico (italiano o Extra Dry)

recipes.method_original: Add to one pint of sweet cider one-half cup of non-alcoholic Vermouth (Italian or Extra Dry). Add the juice of one-half lemon and the juice of one orange. Add a few drops of bitters. Mix gently. Put it on ice to get very cool. Do not shake it. Pour out in glasses, garnished with maraschino cherries.
recipes.method_es: Añadir a una pinta de sidra dulce media taza de vermut no alcohólico (italiano o Extra Dry). Añadir el jugo de medio limón y el jugo de una naranja. Añadir unas pocas gotas de bitters. Mezclar suavemente. Poner en hielo para que se enfríe mucho. No agitar. Servir en vasos, decorados con cerezas al marrasquino.
recipes.raw_text: The "Gentle Annie". Add to one pint of sweet cider one-half cup of non-alcoholic Vermouth (Italian or Extra Dry). Add the juice of one-half lemon and the juice of one orange. Add a few drops of bitters. Mix gently. Put it on ice to get very cool. Do not shake it. Pour out in glasses, garnished with maraschino cherries.

ingredients.item_es: vermut no alcohólico (italiano o Extra Dry)

recipes.method_original: Add to one quart of medium strong cold tea four tablespoonfuls of lemon juice, four tablespoonfuls of non-alcoholic Vermouth (Italian or Extra Dry). Shake well, with ice. When serving, garnish each glass with a slice of lemon. A refreshing drink. Can be served for afternoon lunch or supper.
recipes.method_es: Añadir a un cuarto (galón estadounidense, ~0,95 L) de té frío de fuerza media cuatro cucharadas de jugo de limón y cuatro cucharadas de vermut no alcohólico (italiano o Extra Dry). Agitar bien con hielo. Al servir, decorar cada vaso con una rodaja de limón. Una bebida refrescante. Se puede servir para el almuerzo o la cena de la tarde.
recipes.raw_text: Iced Tea Tango. Add to one quart of medium strong cold tea four tablespoonfuls of lemon juice, four tablespoonfuls of non-alcoholic Vermouth (Italian or Extra Dry). Shake well, with ice. When serving, garnish each glass with a slice of lemon. A refreshing drink. Can be served for afternoon lunch or supper.

ingredients.item_es: vermut no alcohólico (italiano o Extra Dry)

recipes.method_original: One cup of Grape Juice. Six tablespoonfuls of non-alcoholic Vermouth (Italian or Extra Dry). Half a cup of water. Two tablespoonfuls of sugar, the juice of one large orange. Dissolve the sugar in water. Cut three thin slices of the orange for the garnishing of the glasses. The rest of the orange squeeze and strain into the water and sugar. Add the Vermouth and Grape Juice. Mix it but do not shake. Put it on the ice for about one hour to get very cold. Pour out into the glasses that have been garnished with the orange slices. More Vermouth can be added according to taste.
recipes.method_es: Una taza de jugo de uva. Seis cucharadas de vermut no alcohólico (italiano o Extra Dry). Media taza de agua. Dos cucharadas de azúcar y el jugo de una naranja grande. Disolver el azúcar en el agua. Cortar tres rodajas finas de la naranja para decorar los vasos. Exprimir y colar el resto de la naranja en la mezcla de agua y azúcar. Añadir el vermut y el jugo de uva. Mezclar pero no agitar. Poner en hielo durante aproximadamente una hora para que se enfríe muy bien. Servir en los vasos previamente decorados con las rodajas de naranja. Se puede añadir más vermut según el gusto.
recipes.raw_text: The Sultan's Secret. One cup of Grape Juice. Six tablespoonfuls of non-alcoholic Vermouth (Italian or Extra Dry). Half a cup of water. Two tablespoonfuls of sugar, the juice of one large orange. Dissolve the sugar in water. Cut three thin slices of the orange for the garnishing of the glasses. The rest of the orange squeeze and strain into the water and sugar. Add the Vermouth and Grape Juice. Mix it but do not shake. Put it on the ice for about one hour to get very cold. Pour out into the glasses that have been garnished with the orange slices. More Vermouth can be added according to taste.

ingredients.notes: por cada taza de jugo combinado
por cada taza de jugo combinado

ingredients.item_es: vermut no alcohólico (italiano o Extra Dry)
ingredients.notes: por cada taza de jugo combinado

recipes.method_original: Squeeze six oranges. Add the juice of one lemon. Measure it. To each cup add a half cup of water and two tablespoonfuls of sugar. Mix well by shaking in the shaker with enough ice to chill. Add two tablespoonfuls of non-alcoholic Vermouth (Italian or extra Dry) to each cup and shake again. Serve in tall glasses. Garnish with small slices of orange or maraschino cherries.
recipes.method_es: Exprimir seis naranjas. Añadir el jugo de un limón. Medir el volumen. Por cada taza, añadir media taza de agua y dos cucharadas de azúcar. Mezclar bien agitando en la coctelera con suficiente hielo para enfriar. Añadir dos cucharadas de vermut no alcohólico (italiano o Extra Dry) por cada taza y agitar de nuevo. Servir en vasos altos. Decorar con pequeñas rodajas de naranja o cerezas al marrasquino.
recipes.garnish: pequeñas rodajas de naranja o cerezas al marrasquino
recipes.raw_text: A Bermuda Sling. Squeeze six oranges. Add the juice of one lemon. Measure it. To each cup add a half cup of water and two tablespoonfuls of sugar. Mix well by shaking in the shaker with enough ice to chill. Add two tablespoonfuls of non-alcoholic Vermouth (Italian or extra Dry) to each cup and shake again. Serve in tall glasses. Garnish with small slices of orange or maraschino cherries.
